**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 12 (p0086) contains an express warranty that the Software will perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects, covering (i) the acceptance period, (ii) one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and (iii) thereafter for as long as Maintenance Services continue. That meets and in fact exceeds the preferred 12-month software conformance warranty.

Supporting points:
- **Remedy exists.** Software Repair Service at no additional charge (p0077); rejection right with return of "any and all amounts paid to Garman hereunder" during acceptance (p0053, p0057); Section 15 preserves recovery of direct damages rather than making repair the sole remedy.
- **No disclaimer risk.** There is no "AS IS" language and no disclaimer of implied warranties anywhere in the agreement, so nothing erodes the express warranty — a favourable position for us that we should not disturb.

Noted in the rationale only (sub-elements, not deviations): no professional/workmanlike warranty for the implementation, training and maintenance services; no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty; and post-acceptance repair does not expressly escalate to replacement or refund. Worth raising conversationally if the agreement is reopened, but not a fallback failure.
